Jethalal gets a big business meeting at his shop with a client from China looking to launch a roti-making machine in Mumbai. Believing his yellow shirt brings him good luck, he desperately looks for it at home, but Daya can't find it in time.
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
